findings.title: The Playwright e2e specs (apps/web/e2e/**, playwright.config.ts) are outside every typecheck target, so the changed journeys.spec.ts is never type-checked by any gate or CI step
findings.reproduction: apps/web/tsconfig.json:14 has "include": ["src", "test", "vite.config.ts", "vitest.config.ts"]. There is no root tsconfig.json (only tsconfig.base.json) and no apps/web/e2e/tsconfig*.json, so `pnpm -r typecheck` (which runs `tsc -p tsconfig.json` per package) never compiles apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts or playwright.config.ts. Playwright transpiles specs without type-checking, and ESLint (which does cover the file) does not report type errors. Failure scenario: a spec change such as passing a wrong type to a helper (e.g. `expectShellReadyForKeyboard(page, nav, lang)` with arguments swapped, or calling a non-existent Locator method on a branch not reached in a given run) passes typecheck, lint and the CI typecheck job, and is only caught (or not) at e2e run time. The reviewer type-checked the round-3 change with a disposable tsconfig outside the candidate (ES2023 + DOM lib, types node): it passes (exit 0), so this is a coverage gap, not a current defect. Evidence: docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/code-security/round-3/e2e-spec-typecheck.log.
findings.expected: The e2e specs and playwright.config.ts are type-checked by `pnpm -r typecheck` and so by CI, e.g. through an apps/web/e2e/tsconfig.json (lib ES2023 + DOM, types node) referenced from apps/web's typecheck script or from a root typecheck step.
findings.actual: No typecheck target includes apps/web/e2e/**. A type error in the e2e specs passes every static gate check. The current spec type-checks cleanly when the reviewer checks it ad hoc.

history.note: Raised by code-security-reviewer in DG1 round 3 (T-DG1-REV-SEC-R3). Pre-existing coverage gap noticed while reviewing the test-only F-DG1-232 change, not a regression. Proposed ID in the code-security range; the orchestrator may renumber.
